title: Court Classic 2.0 Low - White Montorso
description:
The Court Classic collection achieves a level of maturity rarely seen in sneakers. Each pair is handcrafted from "heritage" materials like Montoroso leather and full-grain leather lining. These are time tested materials that we've been using in our footwear for generations. The Court Classic low takes sneakers to a new level of sophistication. You can freely pair them with chinos or slacks for the office or find them just as well suited with denim on the weekends. You'll find each pair to be comfortable, durable, and great looking. Best of all, they will only get better with age as each one of these heritage materials was chosen for it's ability to age gracefully. Made in Maine, USA.
In addition, we’ve improved the comfort of the uppers by adding a foam padded collar and tongue, lightweight leather lining, and a new comfort foam footbed. We’re confident these will be the most comfortable and best looking sneakers in your closet.
